name: Davriel's Entity
description: The entity bound to Davriel that confirmed Tacenda carried part of the Bog Entity.

description_citations.text: "Tacenda Verlasen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Davriel's Entity confirms Tacenda carries part of the Bog Entity; the Bog is found empty and Whisperers besiege them.
timeline.quote: Davriel's Entity confirmed that she carried part of the Bog Entity

citation.text: "Tacenda Verlasen", section "Search for the truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Davriel's Entity confirms Tacenda carries part of the Bog Entity, but the Bog is empty and they are besieged by Whisperers.
timeline.quote: Davriel's Entity confirmed that she carried part of the Bog Entity

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "Search for the truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Davriel steals the Entity by pulling it from the mind of a dying man, becoming hunted by the man's allies.
timeline.quote: Ever since stealing the Entity — pulling it from the mind of a dying man — Davriel had been able to sense its vast potential.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Davriel draws on the Entity once, destroying both armies in a struggle to claim a throne.
timeline.quote: Davriel had used the power of the Entity only once, three years before his arrival on Innistrad.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Davriel's Entity confirms Tacenda carries part of the Bog Entity.
timeline.quote: Davriel's Entity confirmed that she carried part of the Bog Entity .

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Davriel refuses to seize Tacenda's power as his Entity urges.
timeline.quote: Unwilling to become a creature that only caused death and destruction, Davriel refused to do it.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Davriel's Entity proclaims him unworthy and threatens to find another host.
timeline.quote: After Davriel refused to absorb the power of the second Entity, his own Entity proclaimed him unworthy and threatened to find another host.
